ptr.note: Call-scoped borrow; no caller pointer retained. Context storage and children remain C-owned; byte buffers have the scalar length/count or backend digest size.

Base64 digest: copies min(AV_BASE64_SIZE(digest size), size) bytes from a NUL-terminated local encoding and, on truncation, writes NUL at dst[size - 1]. Never writes more than AV_BASE64_SIZE(digest size) <= 89 bytes; size may be any positive int up to the buffer length (INT_MAX for longer buffers). size 0 writes dst[-1] (out of bounds): must be positive. No retention.
